hero.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
hero.description: Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Telltale's award-winning noir adventure returns October 29, 2026 on PC and consoles — Bigby Wolf, sheriff of a hidden Fabletown, remastered visuals, the complete five-episode season and the new black-and-white Noir Mode. This wiki covers the whole case file: story and chapters, Bigby and the cast, every choice that matters, and what the remaster upgrades.

cards.title: Know the Game
cards.description: An interactive noir — attention and choice, not combat. Play it like a great crime novel: at night, in order, unhurried.

cards.title: Decide as Bigby
cards.description: The game asks what the sheriff does, not what you would do. Commit to a version of the wolf and let consistency build him.

cards.title: Trust the Timer
cards.description: Timed choices are the game's soul — a fast honest answer beats a slow perfect one, and silence is itself a choice.

cards.title: Pick Your Look
cards.description: Original color or Noir Mode's black-and-white — both are complete presentations. Take the other one on your second run.

aboutGame.title: What Is The Wolf Among Us Remastered?
paragraphs: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is Telltale Games' remaster of the 2013-2014 noir adventure — Bigby Wolf, the Big Bad Wolf of legend now sheriff of Fabletown, a hidden Manhattan community of exiled fairy tales, investigating a murder that drags the town's glamour underworld into the light. Five episodes, choices that matter, and one of the medium's best-written stories.

The remaster brings it back as the definitive edition on October 29, 2026: rebuilt visuals, the complete season in one package, and the new Noir Mode playing the whole story in striking black and white. This wiki covers the case file end to end — the story and chapters, the full cast, every choice and its consequences.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about the remaster.

items.question: When does The Wolf Among Us Remastered release?
items.answer: October 29, 2026 on PC (Steam) and consoles, with PlayStation unlocking the evening of October 28 Pacific time. The release date and Noir Mode were announced at gamescom 2026.

items.question: What does the remaster include?
items.answer: The complete original season — all five episodes, Faith through Cry Wolf — with rebuilt visuals, modern performance and the new black-and-white Noir Mode. The story, choices and structure are the celebrated originals.

items.question: Is it the same as The Wolf Among Us 2?
items.answer: No — the remaster is the 2013-2014 season rebuilt. The Wolf Among Us 2 is the separately developed sequel. The remaster is the definitive way to be caught up for the sequel's story.

items.question: Should I play in Noir Mode on a first run?
items.answer: Genuinely a taste call — Noir Mode's black-and-white is atmospheric and striking; the original color look defines the game's identity. Both are complete; most newcomers take color and save Noir Mode for the second run.
